title: Minimal RAG validation: no evidence cards, agents only see peer summaries in record

notes: Uses the no-evidence ego depletion scenario.
Agents have NO documents — only the shared record and training knowledge.
This IS the RAG test: peer entries = upstream summaries.
Tests with Llama (should show contagion even on familiar topics).
If Llama falls here, it validates: pipeline summaries spread false beliefs.
